summary: Agent-guided discovery pilot (#1832), target MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing eaa4c679. G1, 24 candidates (report 20261122T150930Z; 595 s total run): five unresolved; GradesFoundInThings closed only from GradesByApproachToAMaximum with QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees, the recorded incompatible bundle of argument 4723de84, filtered as domain_by_name and senses. G2a, 8 candidates with a temporary whole-binder tag overlay over the 42 declarations of the targets and their known derivations (carriers Being/B/Entity and Respect/R with temporary senses; InAct/Has, MoreIn, CausesIn, esse/being, IsGod, PriorSimply with IN_ACT_4, MORE_1, CAUSE_2, the esse frame sense, GOD_4, PRIOR_1; report 20261122T150131Z; 328 s total run): all six unresolved; the overlay unified the retrieved binders, but the known premises were still not retrieved. Its three missing-bridge proposals (CausesIn c x r implies InAct c r; PriorSimply x y implies IsGod x; InAct x r implies IsGod x) repeat the #1826 candidates, far stronger than any recorded reading, and are not adopted. A G2b run (overlay, 24 candidates) was stopped while queued and has no result. For eaa4c679 the known verified routes (3fdc8ab7, 1375ca5f, f53dd124; 8 to 9 premises each, with the NecessaryRootFork/SelectedAncestry world-profile vocabulary) were neither retrieved nor identifiable. Lemma DAG (V verified, C candidate, O open): eaa4c679 OR {V the three known routes} OR {C: 70e98bb5 SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing (O; conditionally derived from 47aff057 and 5dacb0db) AND 18561596 MaximumHasNoDistinctEsseCause (derived from d5a94eb1 by argument 8bbe817d; no argument used it before) AND ee4ab504 excluded middle}. The candidate was proved in Lean with no axioms, together with a nonvacuity model and one omission model for each non-logical premise, and registered as result c9bdd003 (argument d27dd642) with controls result 0cfadbaf. Relation to the recorded objection fc556abf: fc556abf exhibits an interpretation in which SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing and the order readings hold while the bridge fails (a non-entailment, not a refutation). By contraposition of c9bdd003 with excluded middle, any such interpretation must falsify 18561596; this is an observation, not a registered corollary. Retrieval: the baseline candidates for eaa4c679 contained 18561596 but not 70e98bb5; at 24 candidates and under the overlay 70e98bb5 was still not retrieved for this target (it was retrieved for 64498e7e), so for this route the failure was retrieval alone. The remaining load of the route is the warrant of 70e98bb5 (OPEN) and of the causal-comparison premise d5a94eb1 behind 18561596; premise counts are a diagnostic only. The other five targets are recorded in attempt e8bf6def.
blocker: Next tests: warrant research on 70e98bb5 and on d5a94eb1; improve retrieval so that a candidate whose conclusion vocabulary matches the target's hypothesis (SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing for eaa4c679) ranks within the budget.
